scope: Roofline diagnosis: dependent-graph slope, actual FlashAttention, final-layer FFN pruning; same-job ablations, no scheduling change

audit_e14.remaining_semantic_error: last-layer FFN output-row pruning omitted; rates were synchronized isolated-op wall rates and F16 GEMM was not FlashAttention

method.hardware_probes: Legacy single-op Q8/F16 GEMM and 64MiB copy; dependent graphs depth1/16 for Q8 and F16 alternating transpose sizes, GQA FlashAttention prefix2048/new512 and 64MiB copy; 2 warmup + 7 samples each; rates from median difference slope, not physical peak
method.roofline_traffic: one KV read pass per decode chunk proxy, not measured DRAM traffic; norms/rope/activation omitted
method.probe_order: legacy initial single-op rates, dependent Q8/F16/FA/copy depth1 then16, repeat legacy single-op probes after continuous graphs, then calibration/evaluation
method.probe_payload: constant synthetic arithmetic for output oracle; copy uses pseudorandom values; distinct per-stage weights/KV buffers; dependent outputs; observed depth ranges must not overlap
method.attention_layout: head-interleaved Q/K/V strides, dense n_kv_max=0, F32 Q/accumulation, FP16 KV, causal mask, Hq16/Hkv8, dk=dv128
method.overhead: 10 batches; corrected raw/calibrated predict 5000 calls, cloned calibration refit 200 calls; all after evaluation

limits: One machine/model/backend; primitive effective rates are proxies, not hardware peak values or pure GPU timestamps
No cold-start, queue, KV-file restore, agent ETA or arbitrary-program complexity estimate
fit_mae is a fitting residual, not a confidence interval; range-based extrapolation is only a warning
Online consumes past evaluation observations after prediction; frozen consumes calibration only
Prediction quality improvement is not measured model-inference speedup; estimator overhead reported separately
Probe order and graph-size effects are observed; GPU clock/temperature and pure GPU timestamps were not measured, so no frequency attribution
One synthetic shape for Q8 and attention rates; small-batch vec kernels, padding, cache traffic and omitted operators still produce error
Correct FFN count slightly worsens raw error after rate correction; compensating model errors remain
No held-out tuning or performance rerun selection; two development probe runs kept separately, including sparse-hint mistake in the first

unit.scope: original cost semantics plus hand-derived one/two-layer FFN output pruning, per-chunk logits, GQA, rates, profiles and invalid-input atomicity

sanitizers.scope: C cost/roofline unit suites; precompiled GGML/Metal not instrumented
